sections.heading: 1. Standing in a sunlit meadow of tall grass
sections.body: This part of a fox naturalist recording the weather follows fox standing in a sunlit meadow of tall grass. Here fox is shown as a small red fox with one torn left ear, wearing a navy blue scarf with white stripes and round brass goggles pushed up on its forehead.
